title_en: PRIVATE HOUSE WITH THREE FLOORS FOR SALE IN LAPRAKE!
description_en: 3-storey private house for sale in the heart of Laprakes! Total construction area 195m2, construction area 65m2, no yard area around. Floor 0 includes a room + toilet as well as a closed garage for your vehicle. Floor 1 includes apartment 1+1 plus toilet. Floor 2 also apartment 1+1 plus toilet. Fully furnished, modestly. In the central area of ​​the capital, there are all the necessary facilities for a family. Being in the heart of Laprak and only 200 meters away from the Trauma Hospital (military hospital), it is an ideal location not only for living but also for investment (hotel/hostel, rooms for rent), an investment that returns the brand in 10 years with proper management! Has regular mortgage documentation! Suitable for credit purchases. For a visit to the property and further details, contact us!
